verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents bulk user exports out of the platform ("migrate your user data into and out of Auth0" and "Import and Export User Data"), and its log streaming exports tenant logs to external analysis services, so a core exit path exists. The evidence never names the export formats, does not show that all data can be exported, and offers no hands-on corroboration that leaving works in practice. A community remark about vendor lock-in is general sentiment, not a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV), evidence of complete data export including tenant configuration and credentials/password hashes, independent or hands-on confirmation of a full exit.
